markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, typical input, and unanimous similar cases; flagged tier 2.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others 0% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 54th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; strongest association with invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce here; low values associate with invasive [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 3, 4, 6) · context · Elevated score; weak spot check, 8/20 acceptable [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Scored high; spot check 0/20 acceptable · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; this case leans on unreliable mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration error was 0.05 on 132 test images (upper bound 0.18); 100% may overstate certainty.
- Cell segmentation failed, so no nuclear measurements support or contradict this call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 5**: confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 6**: verify mitoses and lymphocytes by eye; spot checks were 0/20 and 8/20.
3. **Region 9**: look for duct-confined atypia; that concept's spot check was only 12/20.
